scope: 50 structural layouts, 62 theme variants: cover, directory, section, closing
method: Combined multi-field stress fill plus PowerPoint text fit; semantic fill and representative contact-sheet inspection. Directory counts and copy from directory-longcopy-validation.json.
planning_rule: Tested characters are empirical reference values, not a universal text guarantee. Always apply current bindings max_chars/max_lines/max_width_units, fill the selected page, inspect PowerPoint rendering and final deck.
source_example_policy: All editable cover, section, and closing text fields must be supplied with real nonempty content. Omitted fields cannot retain source examples.
